name: Venomcraft
theme: Apotheosis of the Apothecary. Poisons crit, poisons never decay under Shadow Mark, every tick is a Cascade trigger.
designNotes: Capstone effect mirrors §10.1: 'Poison can crit. Your poison stacks no longer decay while you have Shadow Mark active.'
Pairs with assassin.json venomcraft path — same id, mirrors path-7 capstone Toxic Saint + amplifies.
8-node compact tree, 3 tiers, ~25 total ranks. Tier-3 capstone gates on Withering Reach.

Engine wiring status (2026-05-05): 6 of 8 nodes wireable today via existing palette (stat:incChaosDamage / stat:ailmentDuration / perStack(poison) / procOnCrit applyTag(poison) / whileTag(poison) damageMult). Poison-can-crit + decay-pause-while-shadow-mark capstone needs Phase F.

nodes.name: Vile Reservoir
nodes.description: Maximum poison stacks +1/2/3 (deepens stack ceiling for snapshot builds).

nodes.name: Poison Mastery
nodes.description: +2/4/6% damage per poison stack on target (rewards stacking before consuming).

nodes.name: Tainted Strike
nodes.description: On crit, +5/10/15/20/25% chance to apply 2 additional poison stacks (Cascade-poison fusion preview).

nodes.name: Withering Reach
nodes.description: Poisoned enemies take +10% damage from your skills (broad whileTag scaler).

nodes.name: Predator's Patience
nodes.description: +5/10/15% damage to poisoned targets (stacks with Withering Reach for deeper poisoned-vulnerability scaling).

nodes.name: Toxic Saint
nodes.description: Poison can crit. Your poison stacks no longer decay while Shadow Mark is active on any target. The §10.1 ascendancy keystone.
